A minimal function which produces EB's bug is as follows:

(DEFUN LOSS (X)
  (LIST (CXR 2 X)
	(CXR 3 X)
	(CXR 4 X)
	(CXR 5 X)
	(CXR 6 X)
	(CXR 7 X)))

Evidently the compiler's particular strategy for compiling CXRs commits
it to eating up registers.
